Entry.JapaneseText: ワンダーシェフ
Entry.EnglishText: Wonder Chef

Entry.JapaneseText: 掟を覚える貫蔵
Entry.EnglishText: Vow-Learning Kanzou

Entry.JapaneseText: 歓迎するおしず
Entry.EnglishText: Welcoming Shizu-chan

Entry.JapaneseText: 懸念する輩蔵
Entry.EnglishText: Concerned Haizou

Entry.JapaneseText: ちっちゃい緋蔵
Entry.EnglishText: Wee L'il Hizou

Entry.JapaneseText: 引越ししたい金蔵
Entry.EnglishText: Wanna-Move Kinzou

Entry.JapaneseText: 背の高いおしん
Entry.EnglishText: Long, Tall Shin-chan

Entry.JapaneseText: 茶摘のおみよ
Entry.EnglishText: Tea-Harvesting Miyo-chan

Entry.JapaneseText: 早いが命の真蔵
Entry.EnglishText: Fleet-Footed Shinzou

Entry.JapaneseText: 強い男好きのおかよ
Entry.EnglishText: Hunk-Seeking Kayo-chan

Entry.JapaneseText: お国訛りのおきょう
Entry.EnglishText: Dialectical Kyou-chan

Entry.JapaneseText: 鬼の角蔵
困っている忍び
Entry.EnglishText: Troubled Shinobi

Entry.JapaneseText: よろず屋 くりきんとん
Entry.EnglishText: Yorozu-ya ・Kurikinton

Entry.JapaneseText: 頭領の屋敷
Entry.EnglishText: Clan Head's Estate

Entry.JapaneseText: 忍者の里
Entry.EnglishText: Ninja Village

Entry.JapaneseText: 見つけてくれて サンキュー！
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, you found me! Thank you~!

Entry.JapaneseText: ご褒美よ！
Entry.EnglishText: Here, a reward!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……では、サラバっ！！
Entry.EnglishText: ...And with that... Farewell!

Entry.JapaneseText: 忍者の掟、その１～！ 忍者は非情たるべき！
Entry.EnglishText: Ninja Code, Number 1~! A ninja must be unfeeling!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ようこそ、 ここは忍者の里です
Entry.EnglishText: ...Welcome. This is the Ninja Village.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私は任務失敗の罰として 忍びの掟を言わされています
Entry.EnglishText: As punishment for failing in my duties, I must recite the code of the shinobi.

Entry.JapaneseText: 他人にいらぬ情けをかけることで、 決断が鈍るのを避けなければ なりません
Entry.EnglishText: We must avoid blunting our judgment with unnecessary feelings toward others.

Entry.JapaneseText: そのため、我々は 非情でいねばならないのです
Entry.EnglishText: For that reason, we must be unfeeling.

Entry.JapaneseText: 忍者の掟、その２～！ 忍者は秘密を洩らすべからず！
Entry.EnglishText: Ninja Code, Number 2~! Ninja must never reveal a secret!

Entry.JapaneseText: 任務のことはもちろん、 自らの素性やこの里の場所すら 他言無用です
Entry.EnglishText: Our duties are one such secret, of course, but this also includes our own identities and the village's location.

Entry.JapaneseText: あなた方ももしこの里の場所を 他に漏らしたりしたら、 わかりますね……？
Entry.EnglishText: It applies to you, as well. If you should let the village of this location slip, you know what will happen, right...?
... ...You know...what will happen...right...? ...

Entry.JapaneseText: 忍者の掟、その３～！ 自らの欲望に屈すべからず！
Entry.EnglishText: Ninja Code, Number 3~! Do not give in to ambition!

Entry.JapaneseText: 忍者はいかなる時もストイックで いなければならないのです
Entry.EnglishText: Ninja must remain stoic in all ways, at all times.

Entry.JapaneseText: 忍者の掟、その４～！その５！ その６！ その７！
Entry.EnglishText: Ninja Code, Number 4~! Number 5! Number 6! Number 7!

Entry.JapaneseText: 掟はまだまだたくさんあります。 多すぎて覚えきれないのです！
Entry.EnglishText: The Code is very long. It's so long, in fact, I can't remember all of it!

Entry.JapaneseText: おやおや、外から いらっしゃった人かい？ 外は大変なことになってるね
Entry.EnglishText: Oh my, you've come here from the outside? It's bad out there, isn't it?

Entry.JapaneseText: この里は七里結界によって 守られてるから、 瘴気もなんとか防げてるよ
Entry.EnglishText: This village is protected by a seven mile barrier, which can just about repel the miasma.

Entry.JapaneseText: この里はなんとか 結界で守られてるけど、 いつまで持つかねぇ
Entry.EnglishText: This village's barrier is more or less protecting us, but I do wonder how long it can hold.

Entry.JapaneseText: 瘴気なんて、未知のものに 関して我々はかなり 勉強不足だからね
Entry.EnglishText: Miasma is unknown to us, and what little information we have isn't nearly enough.

Entry.JapaneseText: おやおや、あんたら、 頭領のお知り合いの子だね、 ゆっくりしていきな
Entry.EnglishText: Oh my, weren't you acquaintances of the head? Please, make yourselves comfortable.

Entry.JapaneseText: こう見えても私も忍者の一人だよ。 っていうか、この村の人間は みんな忍者だけどね
Entry.EnglishText: Despite appearances, I am also one of the ninja. Well, everyone in this village is a ninja, after all.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私たち忍者は、普段は こういう普通の格好を してるものなのさ
Entry.EnglishText: On the average day, even we ninja look as normal as anyone else.

Entry.JapaneseText: で、いざという時には戦闘装束に 着替えて、任務を行うんだ。 あの服、きつくてね
Entry.EnglishText: But, when needs must, we change into our battle attire, and carry out our missions. Those clothes are a pretty tight fit, actually.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Suzu>ちゃんは……おっと、 頭領は本当あんな小さいなりで しっかりやってるよ
Entry.EnglishText: <Suzu> is... Oops, I mean, the clan head is so small, and yet she carries out her role so well.

Entry.JapaneseText: 最初は不安だったけどね さすが生まれながらにしての 忍者だね
Entry.EnglishText: I was worried at first, but, after all, she was born a true ninja.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私たちは、６歳くらいから 修行に入って、少しずつ 忍者になっていくのさ
Entry.EnglishText: We begin our training at about 6 years old, and slowly develop into ninja.

Entry.JapaneseText: 頭領は１歳の時には 水グモに乗って、３歳で もうムササビの術使ってたよ
Entry.EnglishText: The clan head was able to use water-walking shoes at 1, and began gliding at 3.

Entry.JapaneseText: 頭領は、忍者の エリート中のエリートさ
Entry.EnglishText: The clan head is an elite even among ninja elite.

Entry.JapaneseText: 知っているか、裏世界には 世界のバランスを取っている 「蝕」の一族というのがいる
Entry.EnglishText: Have you heard of the "Eclipse" clan, who protect the world's balance from the shadows?

Entry.JapaneseText: だが、今回のプルートの件、 連中が動いている気配がない
Entry.EnglishText: They don't seem to have made any moves regarding the situation with Pluto.

Entry.JapaneseText: ということはこの出来事は 世界にとって自明と いうことなのかもしれない
Entry.EnglishText: Then perhaps these events are just a part of the natural order of the world.

Entry.JapaneseText: 「蝕」の一族は、世界の成長を 阻害する者や物を排除するため、 「大いなる兄弟」の命で動くのだ
Entry.EnglishText: The "Eclipse" clan follow the orders of the "Big Brothers," and eliminate those who impede the world's development.

Entry.JapaneseText: 裏世界で活動しているという 意味では、我々のライバルだが 根本的に活動原理が異なる
Entry.EnglishText: Acting in the shadows makes them our rivals, in a sense, but our fundamental purposes are different.

Entry.JapaneseText: 我々は世界の裏で暗躍する一族、 決して世界の表舞台には 立つことはないのだ
Entry.EnglishText: We are a clan who operate only in secret, and will never stand in the public limelight.

Entry.JapaneseText: そのため、時空戦士として、 頭領の名前が歴史に残ったのは 少し頭が痛い……
Entry.EnglishText: So, for our clan head to appear in the historical record as a Hero of Time... My head hurts, thinking about it.

Entry.JapaneseText: 我々の一部は頭領の名前を、 歴史から消すために、 鋭意活動中だ
Entry.EnglishText: Some among us are making their best efforts to wipe our clan head's name from the historical record.

Entry.JapaneseText: しかし、過去から現代と 広い時間に渡って広まった 名前を消すことは容易ではない
Entry.EnglishText: However, it is not simple to make unknown a name which has been known for such a great many years.

Entry.JapaneseText: 頭領とは言え、 彼女はまだまだ子どもだ。 我々がフォローしていかねば
Entry.EnglishText: Though we call her our clan head, she is still only a child. We must do all we can to support her.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……あっ……これは 頭領には秘密にしてくれ
Entry.EnglishText: ...Ah... Don't tell her I said that.

Entry.JapaneseText: 頭領はダオスとの戦いに 参加されてから、少し 変わられたようだ
Entry.EnglishText: Our clan head has changed a little since she participated in the battle against Dhaos.

Entry.JapaneseText: 成長されているのに、 以前よりもぐんと 子どもっぽい表情をされる
Entry.EnglishText: Though she's grown since then, she's actually had much more of a childish aspect to her.

Entry.JapaneseText: 由々しきことなのに、 どこかでほっとする 自分がいる……
Entry.EnglishText: It's a matter of grave concern, but it's also come as a bit of a relief, somehow...

Entry.JapaneseText: ぼく、らいねんから、 ニンジャシュギョーするの。 だいぞーぶかな？
Entry.EnglishText: From nekst year, I'll be trayning as a ninjuh. Will I be okies?

Entry.JapaneseText: けんでたたかれたら、 いたくないかな？ ちゃんとできるかな？
Entry.EnglishText: If I get hit by a sord, won't it hurt? Can I reely do this?

Entry.JapaneseText: ぼく、まだ５さいだから、 シュギョーはらいねんからなの
Entry.EnglishText: I'm only 5 years owld, so my trayning starts nekst year.

Entry.JapaneseText: さいしょは、うえきをジャンプ すっところからはじめんだよ？
Entry.EnglishText: For the furst thing, to start with, I'll try jumping over a pottid plant?
Entry.Notes: not sure how to translate this ngl 5 year old with broken japanese grrr

Entry.JapaneseText: こどもようの“うにふぉーむ”、 おじいにかってもらったの
Entry.EnglishText: My gramps got me a "youneeform" for kids.

Entry.JapaneseText: シュギョーのときに きるふくなんだって
Entry.EnglishText: It's the clowthes I need to wear for trayning.

Entry.JapaneseText: “うにふぉーむ”きて、 ぼくもいちにんまえの ニンジャなのだっ！
Entry.EnglishText: If I wear that "youneeform," I'll be a fool-fledged ninjuh!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ちょーしにのってたら、 おじいにおこられちったの……
Entry.EnglishText: ...If I get carreed away, my gramps will be mad at me...

Entry.JapaneseText: おじいに、ニンジャシュギョーの “うにふぉーむ”をとられたの
Entry.EnglishText: I got a ninjuh trayning youneeform from gramps.

Entry.JapaneseText: シュギョーはらいねんから だっていわれたの
Entry.EnglishText: He sed I'll start trayning nekst year.

Entry.JapaneseText: ニンジャシュギョーは らいねんからだって
Entry.EnglishText: But, um, ninjuh trayning is nekst year...

Entry.JapaneseText: らいねんからっていつ～？ らいねんってすごく とおくない？
Entry.EnglishText: Wen is "from nekst year"? Isn't nekst year a reely long time away?

Entry.JapaneseText: 外の世界は瘴気によって 荒れに荒れているらしいな
Entry.EnglishText: The world outside has been in a terrible state due to the miasma, I hear.

Entry.JapaneseText: だが、これしきのことで、 心乱す我々ではない
Entry.EnglishText: But, such a small ordeal is not nearly enough to perturb us.

Entry.JapaneseText: 我ら忍びはどんな時も 慌てず騒がずがモットーだ
Entry.EnglishText: Our motto as shinobi is, "At all times, in all things, calm and collected, without fear."

Entry.JapaneseText: そうでなくては、 一流の忍びにはなれん
Entry.EnglishText: Those who feel otherwise can never become a top shinobi.

Entry.JapaneseText: 先のダオス戦役の時の時空戦士に、 おまえたち……
Entry.EnglishText: The Heroes of Time from Dhaos's War, and now your group, too...

Entry.JapaneseText: 少しよそ者がこの場所を 知りすぎた。そろそろ、 ここも退き時だな
Entry.EnglishText: A few too many outsiders know of our village now. We'll have to leave here soon.

Entry.JapaneseText: 我々は古くから里の場所を 外の者に知られるたび、 転々としてきたのだ
Entry.EnglishText: From long ago, we've continuously moved our village as soon as too many people from outside have learned of it.

Entry.JapaneseText: いつおまえたちが 我々の敵になるかは わからないからな
Entry.EnglishText: We never know when you may become our enemies, you see.

Entry.JapaneseText: 忍者の里は 人に知られるたび、 場所を移してきた
Entry.EnglishText: The Ninja Village moves to a new place whenever its current location becomes known to people.

Entry.JapaneseText: この場所にはずいぶん長い間、 住んできて馴染んできたが、 名残惜しんでばかりもいられん
Entry.EnglishText: We've been here for a long time, and we've grown used to it, but we cannot hesitate forever.

Entry.JapaneseText: 次の忍者の里の候補地選びは もう始まっている。だが、 適した土地がなかなか見つからん
Entry.EnglishText: We've already begun selecting the next site for the village. It's just that finding a good site has been hard.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今の時代、どこへ行っても、 人の姿がある。そんなところに 忍者の里は作れないからな
Entry.EnglishText: In this era, wherever one goes, there are people there...and we can't build a village somewhere people already live.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Suzu>ちゃん、カワイソウ…… お父さんとお母さんを いっぺんに亡くすなんて……
Entry.EnglishText: I feel so bad for <Suzu>... She lost both her parents at the same time...

Entry.JapaneseText: それなのに、気丈に振る舞って、 頭領してるなんて……
Entry.EnglishText: But despite that, she acts so strong, and she's even leading the clan...

Entry.JapaneseText: 私なら、あんなことあったら、 <Suzu>ちゃんみたいには できないな……
Entry.EnglishText: If something like that happened to me, I wouldn't be able to handle it like <Suzu> has...

Entry.JapaneseText: 当たり前か…… 忍者としての年季が違うもの。 私、まだ見習いだし……
Entry.EnglishText: I guess it's only natural... She's a much more experienced ninja than I am. I'm just an apprentice...

Entry.JapaneseText: 昔はよく<Suzu>ちゃんと影踏みとか はないちもんめで遊んだよ、 修行の合間によくね
Entry.EnglishText: In the past, <Suzu> and I would play shadow-tag and Hana Ichi Monme. Inbetween training sessions, you know?

Entry.JapaneseText: 今じゃそんなふうに 仲良くしてもらえないかな。 頭領だもんね
Entry.EnglishText: She probably can't be that friendly with me anymore, since she's the clan head now.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Suzu>ちゃんと同い年なのに、 どんどん私、置いてかれるなぁ
Entry.EnglishText: <Suzu> and I are the same age, but I just fall further and further behind.

Entry.JapaneseText: 背ばっかりでっかくなって、 全然、忍者の技とか 身につかないんだもの
Entry.EnglishText: My height keeps going up and up, but my skills as a ninja aren't growing at all.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Suzu>ちゃんとはよく遊んだけど なんか友達って感じじゃ ないのよね
Entry.EnglishText: I played a lot with <Suzu>, but I don't feel like we're really friends or anything.

Entry.JapaneseText: なんか遊んでもらってる って感じで……友達っていうより 先生って感じかな……
Entry.EnglishText: It was more like she was doing me a favor by playing with me... She felt kind of like my teacher, I guess...

Entry.JapaneseText: <Suzu>ちゃん、私より ずっと大人なんだよね
Entry.EnglishText: <Suzu>'s much, much more mature than I am.

Entry.JapaneseText: いつも冷静沈着で…… あんなふうになりたいっていう みんなの憧れなんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: She's always so calm and collected... Everyone wants to be more like her, actually.

Entry.JapaneseText: お茶はこの里の名物なの。 毎年美味しいお茶が取れるのよ
Entry.EnglishText: Our village is famous for its tea. Our leaves are delicious every year.

Entry.JapaneseText: 外の瘴気が、今年の一番茶に 悪影響を与えなきゃいいんだけど
Entry.EnglishText: I'm hoping the miasma outside doesn't have a negative impact on this year's first flush, though.

Entry.JapaneseText: お茶が採れたら行商人に化けて、 外の街で売り歩くの。うちのお茶、 とても評判がいいのよ
Entry.EnglishText: Once I've harvested the tea, I take up work as a traveling merchant. Our tea is well-reviewed in many towns.

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、世界がこんな状態じゃ、 それも難しいわよね……
Entry.EnglishText: But with the world like this, that might be difficult to do this year, too...

Entry.JapaneseText: お茶栽培は忍者稼業の片手間で やれるような生半可なものじゃ 本当はないのよ
Entry.EnglishText: Cultivating tea isn't just a hobby one can pursue during time off from ninja work. I mean it. It's nothing so shallow as that.

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、仕事をしながら、 いかに美味しいお茶を作るかも 忍者修行の一環なの
Entry.EnglishText: But, seeing how delicious a tea you can create while still working is a part of one's ninja training, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: 苦労に苦労を重ねて 手塩にかけて栽培したお茶は 本当にカワイイのよ
Entry.EnglishText: The tea I have cultivated personally, through great toil and trouble, is very precious to me.

Entry.JapaneseText: 売りたくないくらいに、 でも、売るけどね。 ドナドナ歌いながら
Entry.EnglishText: So much so that I don't really want to sell it. But, I will sell it. While singing "Donna Donna."

Entry.JapaneseText: まる忍印のお茶が 今年も世界各地で 流通を始めたわよ
Entry.EnglishText: Tea bearing our clan's "Shinobi" character (忍) has begun spreading throughout the land this year, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: たぶん、あなたたちも 知らず知らずの間に飲んでるわ
Entry.EnglishText: You've probably drunk some yourselves, without knowing.

Entry.JapaneseText: まるに「忍」 コレが目印よ！
Entry.EnglishText: The "Shinobi" symbol (忍), in a circle! That's how you'll know it's ours!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……オレは韋駄天真蔵、 各地で活動をする仲間の 元へ密書を運ぶのが使命……
Entry.EnglishText: ...I am Idaten Shinzou. My mission is to deliver secret messages intact to our allies throughout the lands...

Entry.JapaneseText: しかし、瘴気のせいで、 里も出られないし、 大切な密書も届けられない
Entry.EnglishText: However, due to the miasma, I can't leave the village—and can't deliver those messages, either.

Entry.JapaneseText: プルートを倒すことも 大切な使命だが、それ以外にも 我々には仕事がある
Entry.EnglishText: Defeating Pluto is an important mission, but there are other also jobs we need to carry out.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……各地に飛んでいる 仲間たちは無事だろうか
Entry.EnglishText: ...I wonder if our allies throughout the lands are all safe right now.

Entry.JapaneseText: 疾風のように大地を駆け、 迅雷のように鋭く行く 韋駄天真蔵、ここにあり！
Entry.EnglishText: Like the wind, racing across the land! Like a lightningbolt, cutting through to his destination! Idaten Shinzou...is here!

Entry.JapaneseText: やはり、忍者は足が命！
Entry.EnglishText: It's true! A ninja lives by his feet!

Entry.JapaneseText: 毎日２時間の走りこみは 欠かさない！
Entry.EnglishText: Two hours of training runs, every day! That's the bare minimum!

Entry.JapaneseText: さ、君たちもオレと一緒に レッツランニング！
Entry.EnglishText: Okay, everyone. Come with me, and... "Let's Running!"

Entry.JapaneseText: オレはこの里一番の 健脚の持ち主、韋駄天真蔵！ 頭領にすら、負けない！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm the bearer of the greatest pair of legs in the village, Idaten Shinzou! Even the clan head can't outrun me!

Entry.JapaneseText: 忍者でなかったならば、 かけっこ大会に出て その名を歴史に刻んだはずだ
Entry.EnglishText: If I weren't a ninja, I'd enter track meets and carve my name into the history books.

Entry.JapaneseText: オレは韋駄天真蔵！ ちなみに韋駄天とは オレの仇名だ！
Entry.EnglishText: I am Idaten Shinzou! Though, Idaten is just a nickname!

Entry.JapaneseText: 足の早い神様にちなんで 前の頭領からいただいた 名前なのだ
Entry.EnglishText: It's the name of a god known for his fleetness of foot. Our previous head chose it for me.

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界が瘴気に満ちて 魔族やプルートが襲ってくる……
Entry.EnglishText: The world is full of miasma and Pluto and his daemons are attacking...

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ……誰か 私を守ってくれる 王子様はいないかしら……
Entry.EnglishText: Ahh... Is there not a prince who will protect me, somewhere out there...?

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔族やプルートを 打ち払ってくれる頼りにできる 素敵な彼氏はいずこに……
Entry.EnglishText: Where is my wonderful, reliable, Pluto-and-Daemon exterminating boyfriend...?

Entry.JapaneseText: そんなものいないのよね。 結局、頼れるのは自分の力だけ だったり……情けない……
Entry.EnglishText: There isn't anyone like that, is there? In the end, I can only rely on my own strength. It's so sad...

Entry.JapaneseText: わたしの好きな男性のタイプは 強い男の人
Entry.EnglishText: My type of man? I like a strong man. That's it.

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界のどこかに“ちゃんぴおん” っていう強い人がいるそうね。 その人がいいわ、私
Entry.EnglishText: Apparently, there's someone out there so strong they call him a "champion." I want him.

Entry.JapaneseText: この里の男たちは、戦い馴れは してるけど、いまいち頼りない のが多いのよね
Entry.EnglishText: The men of this town are accustomed to battle, but they're mostly unreliable.

Entry.JapaneseText: 頭領は<Suzu>ちゃんでしょ。 女の方が強いのよ、実際。 私に戦って勝てる人がいいわ、私
Entry.EnglishText: I mean, the clan head is <Suzu>. The women of this town are just stronger. I need a man who can beat me in a fight.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私は私よりも強い人に 会いにいくの……
Entry.EnglishText: I should go out and try to find a man stronger than me...

Entry.JapaneseText: その人に戦いを挑んで負けたら、 求婚して、一族に引き入れるの。 いいアイデアでしょ？
Entry.EnglishText: If I challenge him to a fight and lose, I'll propose to him, and force him to join the clan. Good idea, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: 私の理想のタイプは、 私をいろんな危険から 守ってくれる強い人なの
Entry.EnglishText: My ideal type of man is a strong one who will protect me from all kinds of danger.

Entry.JapaneseText: あ、自分の身くらい自分で 守れるでしょ、ってのはなしね そういう問題じゃないから
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, you think I'm strong enough to protect myself? Of course I am, but that's not the point.

Entry.JapaneseText: あら、こんな時に 来てもーても ぶぶ漬けも出せへんよ
Entry.EnglishText: Oh my, if you come here at such a time, we can't even offer you tea and rice.

Entry.JapaneseText: プルート討伐の準備で 里は忙しいでな。 またおいでや
なにもこんな時に 来んでもええのに
